domains.heading: Mail domains
domains.subtitle: Domains this server receives and sends mail for. A domain must be a hostname of one of the account's sites.
domains.emptyDescription: Add the first domain above, then create its mailboxes and publish the DNS records it needs.
domains.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filters, or clear them to see every mail domain.

form.heading: Add a mail domain
form.hint: The domain must already be a hostname of one of this account's sites. Mail will not be delivered until its DNS records are published.

domains.rotated: A new DKIM key was started for {name}. Publish the new DKIM record.
domains.confirmRemove: Remove this domain? Its mailboxes, aliases and forwarders stop working and the mail they hold is deleted.
domains.confirmRotate: Start a new signing key? Mail is signed with the new key at once, so its DKIM record must be published before it is trusted.

dns.title: DNS records for {name}
dns.intro: Publish these records where the domain's DNS is managed. This panel does not publish them for you.
dns.emptyDescription: The panel has no records for this domain yet.

mailboxes.heading: Mailboxes
mailboxes.subtitle: Mailboxes of your mail domains. The login is the full address.
mailboxes.emptyDescription: Create the first mailbox above. Add its domain first if you have none.
mailboxes.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filters, or clear them to see every mailbox.

form.heading: Create a mailbox

errors.localPartRequired: Enter the name before the at sign.
errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least {n} characters.
errors.quotaInvalid: Enter the size limit as a whole number of MiB.
errors.quotaRange: The size limit must be between {min} and {max} MiB.

form.hint: You choose the password and it is never shown again. Use the full address as the login in a mail client.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.sendLimit: Messages it may send per hour
edit.suspendedHint: The panel has suspended this mailbox, so it cannot be switched on from here.

errors.sendLimitInvalid: Enter the send limit as a whole number.
errors.sendLimitRange: The send limit cannot exceed {max} per hour.

password.title: New password for {name}
password.hint: The new password works at once. A mail client that is already connected stays connected until it reconnects.

mailboxes.confirmRemove: Remove this mailbox? The mail it holds is deleted and cannot be recovered.

aliases.heading: Forwarders and aliases
aliases.subtitle: Addresses that deliver to other mailboxes or forward to outside addresses, and the catch-all for a domain.
aliases.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filters, or clear them to see every alias.

form.heading: Create an alias or forwarder

errors.localPartRequired: Enter the name before the at sign.
errors.targetsRequired: Enter at least one address to deliver to.
errors.targetsTooMany: An alias can deliver to at most {n} addresses.

form.hint: A catch-all takes every message sent to the domain that no other address claims, so it has no name of its own.

edit.title: Destinations of {name}
edit.hint: The new list replaces the old one. The address and the type stay as they are.

aliases.confirmRemove: Remove this address? Mail sent to it is refused afterwards.
